entries.title: Day 0: create Threads @devshark.app, bio + first pin
entries.body: Create the Threads profile from the @devshark.app Instagram account (same handle). Bio = offer (learn web dev with graded quizzes and 770 coding tasks), proof (116 free tasks, no card), next step (devshark.app link with utm_source=threads&utm_medium=bio). Pin the first QOTD once posted. Record the Threads URL for client/product-catalog.ts SOCIAL_PROFILES.threads (productDependency).
assets: Profile image: 03-favicon.jpg wave mark from devshark-brand

entries.title: Reply hour: 5 replies to bigger dev accounts (Thu)
entries.body: 25 min: open the saved list of 15–20 larger dev-education/creator accounts on Threads (e.g. freeCodeCamp, roadmap.sh, Boot.dev, JavaScript Mastery, Fireship, Theo, Kent C. Dodds, Josh Comeau, Addy Osmani, Wes Bos, Sara Soueidan, Kevin Powell, Cassidy Williams, Syntax.fm, Web Dev Simplified — verify each has a Threads profile on day 0). Reply within the first hour of their fresh posts with a concrete, useful sentence (a fact, a counter-example, a one-line snippet), never 'great post' and never a link. Also answer every reply on our own posts from the previous day (creator-reply lift, Buffer 2026: +42 % on Threads). marketingShark's replyPolicy is draft_only, so replies are owner-written.
entries.cta: 5 substantive replies + all own-thread replies answered
tipRefs: Rebuild platform assumptions for 2026: Instagram sends and originality, Threads replies and time viewed, LinkedIn dwell as a hypothesis
entries.measure: profile visits from replies (Threads Insights), new followers per day

entries.title: QOTD #1: JS: 2 ** 3 + 1
entries.body: Text post, no image needed (code in backticks renders as text): 'What does `2 ** 3 + 1` evaluate to?'  A) 16  B) 9  C) 7  D) 6. Ask for the letter and one sentence why. Do not reveal the answer in the post. At 18:00 reply to own post with the answer (B) and the bank explanation: '`**` binds tighter than `+`, so it is 8 + 1.' Source: devShark question bank (lib/roadmap-questions-*.ts), tag JavaScript. Link only in that answer reply: devshark.app/quiz?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=qotd. Draft comes from marketingShark's quiz package Threads caption (Queue 07:00); owner approves and posts manually until quorum#587 lands.
tipRefs: Rebuild platform assumptions for 2026: Instagram sends and originality, Threads replies and time viewed, LinkedIn dwell as a hypothesis

entries.title: Quiz carousel (MS Thu package): CSS content-box width
entries.body: marketingShark quiz package, 5 slides 4:5 1080×1350: 1 hook with the question, 2 the four options (works alone as a second cover), 3 'think about it' with the intro hint, 4 the answer + one-paragraph explanation from the bank, 5 footer 'Try one, no signup → devshark.app'. Owner approves in Queue, downloads frames, posts manually (quorum#587 open). Caption: the question again in text (searchable), no hashtags beyond 3–5 topical (#css #webdev #frontend). Format: 4:5 1080×1350, one ratio per deck, headline 3–8 words at 40 px+, slide 2 works as a second cover. Caption ends with one CTA; link in bio carries utm_source=instagram&utm_medium=bio. Alt text on every slide (queue policy).
entries.cta: Save it for later / try the free version at devshark.app
assets: marketingShark package frames (Design Lab) + one real product screenshot
tipRefs: Pace decks at 6 to 10 slides and design slide 2 as a second cover
Make 4:5 the master canvas and lock one ratio per deck
Draft every cover from a tagged hook pattern, then test the second line
Pilot useful slideshow content with a measurable next action
entries.measure: saves and sends per reach after 48 h; profile visits

entries.title: QOTD #2: CSS: content-box width
entries.hook: `width: 300px; padding: 20px; border: 5px solid; box-sizing: content-box`. How w
entries.body: Text post, no image needed (code in backticks renders as text): '`width: 300px; padding: 20px; border: 5px solid; box-sizing: content-box`. How wide is the border box?'  A) 300px  B) 350px  C) 345px  D) 325px. Ask for the letter and one sentence why. Do not reveal the answer in the post. At 18:00 reply to own post with the answer (B) and the bank explanation: 'Padding and border are added on both sides: 300 + 40 + 10.' Source: devShark question bank (lib/roadmap-questions-*.ts), tag CSS. Link only in that answer reply: devshark.app/quiz?utm_source=threads&utm_medium=post&utm_campaign=qotd. Owner picks it from the bank (5 min); marketingShark has no package for this day's quiz.
